name: io.github.borgels/mcp-server-pipedrive
title: Pipedrive
description: Unofficial MCP server for Pipedrive CRM: deals, persons, organizations, activities and notes.

environmentVariables.name: PIPEDRIVE_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: The personal API token of a Pipedrive user (Personal preferences > API).

environmentVariables.name: PIPEDRIVE_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Enable the write tools (create and change deals, persons, organizations, activities and notes; move deals).

environmentVariables.name: PIPEDRIVE_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Path of the JSONL audit log. Write tools refuse to run if it cannot be written.
